company.name: Bitwarden
company.shortDescription: A safe place to keep all your passwords, with a free plan that most people find is enough.
company.planHelp: Sign in at vault.bitwarden.com, open 'Settings' and then 'Subscription'. It shows whether you are on Free, Premium or Families and when it renews.

features.label: People with their own private account
features.question: How many people need their own private password store?
features.help: The Families plan gives 6 people their own account, each with the full paid features.

features.label: Built-in security codes
features.question: Would you like Bitwarden to also produce the six-digit security codes some websites ask for?
features.help: Some banks and websites send you a short code to type in. Bitwarden can make these for you so you do not need a separate app.

features.label: Letting someone in if something happens to you
features.question: Would you like to name a trusted person who could get into your passwords if you were unwell or passed away?

features.label: Storage for documents and files
features.question: Do you also need somewhere safe to keep scanned documents and files?
features.help: The free plan has none. The paid plans give 5 GB each, which is plenty for documents.

features.label: Checks on how safe your passwords are
features.question: Would you like Bitwarden to check whether your passwords are weak, reused, or leaked?

features.label: Sharing passwords with your family
features.question: Do you want to share some passwords with your family while keeping the rest private?
features.help: The free plan lets you share with one other person only. The Families plan allows unlimited sharing between the 6 members.

plans.name: Free
plans.bestFor: Most people. Unlimited passwords on unlimited devices, free forever.
plans.notes: Free for one person, with unlimited passwords and unlimited devices, the apps for phone, computer and browser, and free sharing with ONE other person. Bitwarden Send is limited to text only. No security codes, no emergency access, no file storage and no password health reports.

plans.name: Premium
plans.bestFor: One person who wants the six-digit security codes, emergency access for a loved one and checks on their password safety.
plans.notes: $19.80 a year, which Bitwarden advertises as $1.65 a month billed annually. This is the standard price, not a promotion. Adds the built-in authenticator for six-digit codes, encrypted file attachments (5 GB), email alias integration, vault health reports with coaching, Bitwarden Send for files as well as text, and 24/7 priority email support.

plans.name: Families
plans.bestFor: A household of up to 6 people, each with their own private store plus shared folders for things everyone uses.
plans.notes: $47.88 a year, which Bitwarden advertises as $3.99 a month billed annually. This is the standard price, not a promotion. Covers 6 people, each getting all the Premium features, with unlimited sharing between family members, unlimited collections, and 5 GB of personal storage per person plus 5 GB shared.

faq.q: Is the free Bitwarden plan good enough?
faq.a: For most people, yes. It stores as many passwords as you like on as many devices as you like, forever, at no cost. You only need Premium if you want the six-digit security codes, emergency access, file storage or the password health checks.
You name a trusted person. If you were unwell or passed away, they can ask for access to your passwords. You set a waiting period, and you can refuse the request during that time if you are able to.

faq.q: Is the Families plan better value than two Premium accounts?
faq.a: Usually yes. Families is $47.88 a year for six people, while two separate Premium accounts would be $39.60 a year for only two people and with no shared folders.

faq.q: How much file storage do I get?
faq.a: Bitwarden's official help pages list 5 GB for Premium, and 5 GB per person plus 5 GB shared on Families. The free plan has none.

notes: All prices and features verified from bitwarden.com/pricing/ and the official help page 'About Bitwarden plans' on 2026-09-21. NOTE ON THE BRIEF: the task expected 1 GB of encrypted file storage on Premium. Both official pages checked now state 5 GB (Premium) and 5 GB per user plus 5 GB shared (Families), so 5 has been recorded.
